newsitem.title: USA: Life USA Holding increases credit pact.
newsitem.headline: Life USA Holding increases credit pact.

text.p: Life USA Holding Inc, a financial services and insurance company, said Thursday it had signed an agreement with two of its reinsurers to extend its line of credit to $50 million from $30 million.
Terms of the agreement were not disclosed.
Life USA said the funds will be used for acquisitions or other investments to expand its operations.

"This will give Life USA additional flexibility in pursuing its ongoing strategy to acquire access to the independent agent distribution channels," said Mark Zesbaugh, chief financial officer, in a statement.
Shares of Life USA were off 1/4 to 12-3/4.
